description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The dataset supplies hourly measurements for ten offshore turbines over a two-month study period. Shifted coordinates provide spatial relationships while withholding the original positions. Its concrete role is spatial modelling of wind conditions across a wind farm. The exact original site and calendar dates are not inferred from the anonymized coordinates. Other DSWE archives cover larger turbine sets or longer histories; the available description does not establish independent physical farms across those collections. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
